reports.headline: The Mine That Eats
reports.body: The old mine {dir} of the village {dist} has started taking men again. {name} went in with a lantern and came out without it, talking about a mouth as wide as the shaft. Something swollen croaks in the deep water there too.

reports.headline: Three Miners Missing
reports.body: Three went down the hillside workings {dir} of here {dist} and none came up. The props are snapped as though something huge pushed through. {name} will not say what {they} heard in the dark.
